name: explorer
description: A Vite-native testing framework. It's fast!

works: Activates in a workspace with a Vitest config or vitest in node_modules and starts Vitest from the project
Test: Refresh Tests (Ctrl+; Ctrl+R) reloads the Vitest configs, Test: Cancel Test Refresh stops it
limits: There is no Testing view yet: test files, suites and tests are not shown
Tests cannot be run from the editor yet; run them in the terminal
No debugging: Diode has no debugger
No coverage: coverage is not shown

readme:
# Vitest

The official Vitest extension: discovers the tests of a Vitest project so the editor can show and run them.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version.

In Diode the test tree reaches the editor, but the Testing view and test runs are not there yet. The extension needs Vitest installed in the project (`node_modules`).
